g.text: Every user-owned table carries owner_id, child tables
included (denormalized), so each one gets its own
owner-scoped EF Core query filter. Exceptions: the
Role, UserRole) and UserPreferences, keyed by user_id.
Secret's owner filter also returns instance rows
(owner_id null); only admins may write those.
Notes are not memory: they live in NoteIndexEntry
(search only). Important note content becomes a normal
Chunk written by the agent, source_ref = note path.
data : json «public key, sign count, name»
id : OwnerId-typed «PK, Identity shares the key type»
id : string «PK, SHA-256 hex of the cookie key»
value : bytes «serialized ticket incl. IdP tokens, Data Protection»
help_marshal_learn : bool «default false; gates learning features»
source : voice | web | task | api | automation
api_token_id : ApiTokenId «FK, null for web / task»
closed_at : DateTimeOffset «token sessions after the idle TTL»
rested_at : DateTimeOffset «idle web session, cleared by its next turn»
loaded_tool_namespaces : json «namespaces beyond core, load order; null = core only»
source : voice | web | task | api | automation
taint_sources : json <<mail | rss | notes | web | mcp:<id>, first tainting step>>
time_to_first_delta_ms : int «null when no delta was sent»
task_id : TaskId «FK» «null for session actions and taskless approvals»
queued : bool «in the approval queue; never confirmed in its session»
run_id : RunId «run that asked; no FK (retention)»
taint : json «[{kind, firstStep}] of that run»
reasons : json «[{code: rule | unresolved_target | taint | quiet_hours_override, detail}]»
language : de | en «language of the reason sentences»
expires_at : DateTimeOffset «~60 s conversation, 10 min approval queue»
status : pending | approved | rejected | dropped | expired | superseded
decided_by : keyword | judge | ui | push | system
task_id : TaskId «FK» «task resumed with the outcome»
run_id : RunId «run that asked; no FK (retention)»
previous_answers : json «answers to earlier requests of the same call»
message : string «server text, web UI only»
server_task_id : string «asking server task; answered with tasks/update»
status : pending | answered | declined | expired | dropped
run_id : RunId «run of the call; no FK (retention)»
server : string «MCP server with apps: true»
tool : string «tool name as the server reports it»
html : string «server-authored, at most 1 MB, sandboxed iframe only»
source_run_id : RunId «unique per owner; no FK (outlives retention)»
history : json «user and assistant text before the turn»
turn_context : string «null for runs recorded before snapshots»
tool_calls : json «tool, canonical args, result, error, untrusted»
candidate : json «models per tier, template, base prompt, judge»
status : queued | running | completed | cancelled | failed
case_id : EvalCaseId «no FK: deleted cases keep results»
calls : json «replayed calls, recorded or not»
cost : decimal «counts against the daily cost cap»
summary : string «idle-time job, at most 120 words»
id : ChunkId «PK, hash(owner_id + scope + project_id + type + normalized title)»
project_id : ProjectId «FK, set iff scope = project»
type : fact | preference | event | procedure | person | device
valid_from : DateTimeOffset «true in the world since»
chunk_a : ChunkId «FK, lower id of the pair»
embedding : float[N] «cosine, N from the embedding model»
job : string «registered job of a system task»
origin_satellite_id : string «policy applies to all runs + children»
origin_session_id : SessionId «background handoff: result joins the session»
trigger_kind : now | at | cron | event | after
trigger_spec : string «time, cron, event filter json or task id»
trigger_once : bool «event only: fire once, then done»
trigger_payload : json «handed to the next run»
status : pending | running | waiting | done | failed | cancelled
name : string «unique (owner_id, name) where name is not null»
tool_policy : json «[tool id globs]; null = template allowlist»
prepare_before : TimeSpan «cron only, at most 12 h»
deliveries : json «[{channel, target, priority, followUp, when, expires, fallback, pendingSince, expiresAt}]»
deliveries_pending : bool «a delivery waits for its conditions»
status : starting | running | done | failed | cancelled
outcome : pending | delivered | coalesced | held | inboxed | expired | fallback
routing : json «requested channel, target, link, actions, ...»
consumed_at : DateTimeOffset «inbox item read by a task»
executor_session_id : Guid «FK» «merge / discard go through its executor»
«unique (owner_id, name) where owner_id is not null»
fingerprint : string «SHA-256 of the latest definition»
approved_fingerprint : string «null for a new tool»
previous_definition_json : string «last approved definition while a change waits»
task_id : TaskId «FK» «waiting task resumed with the outcome»
language : de | en «of the calling turn»
taint_kind : string «null when the tool is trusted»
asked_inputs : json «input request keys already asked»
drafts_folder : string «when no folder has special-use Drafts»
kind : image | svg | video | model3d | code | diff | pdf | markdown | html | other
source_reference : string «task id, message ref or printer snapshot»
path : string «relative to the notes repository»
position : int «section order in the file»
file_hash : string «SHA-256 of the file when indexed»
entity : string «table of the seeded row, e.g. runs»
row_id : string «primary key of the seeded row (no FK)»
«demo mode: marshal demo reset deletes exactly these rows»
